youtube_title: First One To React Does All The Thanksgiving Dishes | Funny Cartoon
description:
After Thanksgiving dinner, Grandma Pearl has one rule: the first one to react does every dish in the kitchen. Marcus and Wes will not crack, not for a three-sleeve sweater, a boyfriend named Chet or cranberry sauce in a shoe. Then Grandma tells them what the winner gets.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #thanksgiving
tiktok_caption: first one to react does all the thanksgiving dishes 🍽️ grandma did not play fair #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #thanksgiving

lines.text: Thanksgiving tradition. First one to react does every dish in this kitchen.
Every dish? Grandma, there are dishes on the stairs.
Then you better not react, Marcus.
Easy. I have not had a feeling since two thousand nineteen.
Good evening. I am the dishwasher. I have been broken since August.
So whoever loses tonight is me.
Faces still. Hands on knees. Go.
Wes.
Marcus.
Nice sweater.
Grandma knitted it. It has three sleeves.
I see that.
Neither man looked at the third sleeve. Impressive.
I am eating this whole drumstick. Sideways. Like corn.
Mm. Very normal.
That drumstick was for breakfast. Nobody reacted. I reacted. On the inside. In my rinse cycle.
Round two. I have an announcement.
Grandma has a boyfriend. His name is Chet.
Okay.
Great.
Chet is fifty one.
Chet is living his best life.
Chet has a truck.
Chet has a truck, gentlemen. Chet.
We are very happy for you and the truck.
Hm. Strong boys. Round three.
I found the photo album.
Which album?
Seventh grade. Marcus. The haircut.
Business in the front. A whole different business in the back.
Mm.
Wes, your lip moved.
It was the drumstick. It is still in there.
Reviewing the replay.
I have the replay. I see everything from down here. Inconclusive.
Fine. Final round. I did not want to do this.
I put the cranberry sauce in Wes's shoe.
Which shoe?
The one you are wearing.
Squishy. Cold. Totally fine.
That is a man who wants to win.
Zero reactions. I have never been so proud of two people I do not like.
Oh. Did I forget to tell you what the winner gets?
The winner gets to not do dishes.
The winner drives me to the big sale. Doors open at five in the morning.
I want a seventy inch television and a recliner. You carry both.
Gentlemen. The rules have changed.
Ah! I am reacting! Look at my face!
No! Me! I gasped! Everyone saw it!
Wow!
Hold on. Reviewing the replay.
Photo finish. Same exact second. I have seen Wes eat soup with a fork, and never this.
A tie. Very rare.
So we both do the dishes?
You both do the dishes. And you both drive me to the sale.
That is two losers.
That is two drivers. Chet's truck is in the shop.
Wait. Chet was the plan the whole time?
Chet reacted first last year. Chet did eleven hundred dishes.
Lovely man. Very warm hands.
Wheels up at four thirty. Wear stretchy pants.
And nobody react when I make this noise.
